verdict.rationale: A hosted analytics SaaS could reasonably publish an AI-training opt-out or no-training data policy, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack addresses whether customer or visitor data is used to train AI models, and there is no opt-out or contractual commitment. The privacy claims (no personal data collected, no consent banner needed) and the self-hosting option are general privacy posture, not an AI-training guarantee, so they are not credited here.
